Name: (AT) Crucifigo-cybxrmurdxr's Joja Animal Abominations
Author: RainbowGirl2124
Description:
[size=5]✦ [/size][size=5]Crucifigo's Joja Animal Abominations﻿ ✦﻿[/size][size=5]

An AiO AT Conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38787865]Crucifigo's[/url]﻿ Joja Animal & Barn/Coop Retextures.

[/size][size=3]Instructions[/size][size=3]:[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]⦁ Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].
⦁ Extract this mod into your [Stardew Valley\Mods] folder.
⦁      Animals: Go to Robin's shop and purchase the "scissors" tool. Equip the scissors and click on the animal whose texture you'd like to replace![/size][size=3]
[size=3]⦁      Buildings: Go to Robin's shop and purchase the "paint bucket" tool. Equip the paint bucket and click on the building whose texture you'd like to replace![/size][size=3]
[/size]
[/size]
[size=5]* All credits go to Crucifigo for the textures and cybxmurdxr for restyling it with AT. *[/size]
All I did was update the naming conventions for 1.6, and made it so the textures can be applied to the coop/barn in all 3 stages (initial, big, and deluxe)
